handoff: Approve: every Wanted item of #147 is met and tested at the model and TUI seams (tabs with counts, each story once, closed reads done, titles on NEEDS YOU rows, 60% list, section counts, ] [ n, version in header); SPEC-cockpit amended; unit 1062 pass, typecheck green. Minor: steps_left counts by step declaration order; prototype keeps absolute paths. Nit: standing word built twice.

findings.title: steps_left counts steps in declaration order, not along the workflow's path
findings.detail:
stepsLeft uses Object.keys(wf.steps).indexOf(step). In a workflow whose rework edges loop back, or whose steps are not declared in path order, 'nearest to done first' is only approximate. Fine for the shipped workflows, which are declared in order, and the stage display is #136's to settle.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Leave as is or note it in the steps_left doc comment; revisit with #136.

findings.title: Committed prototype imports from an absolute path on the author's machine
findings.detail:
The prototype's imports and model.json carry /Users/jakubpruszynski/... paths. The README says so, and the spec asks for the gist committed as-is as the record, so this is accepted. It will not run elsewhere without editing.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: None needed; it is a throwaway record.

findings.title: The done/dropped/not started wording is built twice
findings.detail:
previewLines and storySummary each map standing() to its display word (done|dropped / 'not started' / '<status> <step>') on their own.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: One helper for the standing's display word.
